description: The perturbational complexity index separated levels of consciousness in single individuals across wakefulness, sleep, anesthesia with three agents, and patients who had emerged from coma.
limitations: PCI is a proxy inspired by integration and differentiation, not a computation of phi.
conflicts_of_interest: Giulio Tononi and Marcello Massimini are co-authors.

sources.quote: PCI reliably discriminated the level of consciousness in single individuals during wakefulness, sleep, and anesthesia, as well as in patients who had emerged from coma and recovered a minimal level of consciousness.
